tools/build.py's PER_FN_TEXT_MOVES table (the rel key does NOT exist there yet;
grep before adding -- duplicate rel keys are silently shadowed, 12F).
WHAT IT DOES: _dirCheck's source (landed w63-a7) reproduces every oracle
instruction, but our reorg converts the `return 1` fall-through into its OWN
return insn (make_return_insns, reorg.c:4289) and steals `li $2,1` into that
return's delay slot, where retail lets the block FALL THROUGH into the shared
`jr $ra`.  cc1 emits, verbatim:
$L56:  .set noreorder / .set nomacro / j $31 / li $2,1 / .set macro / .set reorder
The row takes the `li` line out of that block, deletes the duplicated `j $31`
with drop_after, and re-inserts the `li` in its place, giving retail's
ANCHORS are label-agnostic; the `after` anchor is LOOKAHEAD-PINNED on the
`j $31` that follows it, so it cannot grab either of the two earlier
`.set nomacro` lines (both are followed by a `beq`).  The `li` take carries
[^\n]* for cc1's trailing hex comment (12F).
